items.summary: Instruction-guided image editors have become highly capable, yet improving them further still depends on human-edited training pairs or external reward models. Such supervision is costly to obtain and can reward plausible failures: a realistic output may leave the requested change undone or alter content that should be preserved. items.summary: We present DreamTrue, a multi-view, cross-embodiment robot world model for action-faithful and physically plausible video prediction. items.title: CSF: Contextual Safety Filtering for Motion Generators
items.summary: Text-conditioned motion generators produce trackable whole-body motion, but they have no notion of scene-dependent safety: the same action may target an object or a person. items.summary: METR's 50\% time horizon measures the human completion time of software tasks that an AI solves with 50\% probability, allowing AI capabilities to be expressed in interpretable units. items.summary: General-purpose robots must perform a wide range of tasks from agile locomotion to dexterous manipulation. items.summary: World models offer a promising alternative to physics-based simulators, yet remain far from practical deployment. items.summary: On a film set, the camera move is committed during a take. Generative video reshooting lets filmmakers change it afterward, but may require hallucinating unrecorded content, a gap sometimes discovered only after leaving the set. items.summary: We propose BrickBench, a benchmark for agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design. Given a prompt, an agent is tasked with producing an assembly that not only satisfies semantic and design criteria, but that can also be physically built. items.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as powerful foundations for robotic manipulation, but their reliance on fixed camera configurations during training makes them brittle to changes in camera count or pose during deployment. items.title: Bi-FORK: Generative Modeling of High-Dimensional Bifurcating Systems
items.summary: Bifurcations are ubiquitous in physical systems, from structural buckling to fluid and climate dynamics, yet they remain largely unexplored in deep learning. items.summary: Recent incidents have highlighted the challenge of monitoring LLM agents and the danger of models deceiving people. items.summary: Generating an egocentric video from a single exocentric recording is a challenging case of novel view synthesis, as the two cameras share little overlap and much of the target view is unobserved.
